relationships.description: Unused warehouse capacity may substitute external storage, subject to feasibility and incremental operating costs.

result.narrative: The analysis of shared capacity between 'Synthetic Phase 7 shared warehouse' and 'SYN-P7-G0001-external storage' reveals that 500 units of capacity can be shared. The tool-computed consumerMonthlyBenefit is 9,000 EUR, providerMonthlyBenefit is 2,000 EUR, and the ecosystemMonthlyBenefit is 11,000 EUR. Over the horizon of 12 months, the ecosystemHorizonBenefit is 126,000 EUR. The zero-change baseline, keeping external storage, results in no net benefit. The sensitivity analysis with higher incremental cost and transition expense shows a consumerMonthlyBenefit of 9,000 EUR, providerMonthlyBenefit of 1,000 EUR, and an ecosystemMonthlyBenefit of 10,000 EUR, with a horizon benefit of 108,000 EUR.
humanDecisions: Confirm the suitability of the shared warehouse for the synthetic commerce worker's needs.
Review the transition expense and incremental operating cost assumptions.

Monitor the financial impact and operational suitability over the 12-month horizon.

providerStatus.modelReadiness: Confirmed only by a successful investigation

narrativeReview.assessment: Every quoted benefit, currency and horizon matches the deterministic calculation, including the zero-change baseline and higher-cost sensitivity. The model uses generic units and mixes some observed facts into its assumptions list. Source data establish cubic metres; both detail views identify model assumptions wording as non-authoritative and preserve separate source records, deterministic inputs and limitations.

limitations: Commerce uses authenticated TLS simulators; no live commercial connectivity or paid production is certified.
Financial comparisons select the latest 20 approved observations per company/currency, not a complete-period financial statement.
Production and shipping quotes remain estimates; no FX conversion or net-profit claim.
Local models can fail or misclassify wording; human review and explicit assumptions remain mandatory.
Provider configuration and credentials remain deployment-managed.
Legacy reference fields without module-provided local lookup data retain explicit reference inputs.
This MVP is not certified commercially production-ready.
